title: Specific genomic targeting of the RNF12/RLIM E3 ubiquitin ligase selectively programmes developmental transcription
authors: Espejo-Serrano C; Aitken C; Tan BF; May DG; Chrisopulos RJ; Roux KJ; Mackintosh SG; Gribnau J; Bustos F; Gontan C; Findlay GM
one_liner_zh: 该文研究E3泛素连接酶RNF12通过染色质招募和底物泛素化调控发育转录，涉及转录因子REX1，但核心是泛素化机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract:
Summary

The E3 ubiquitin ligase RNF12/RLIM controls developmental gene expression and is mutated in the X-linked intellectual disability disorder Tonne-Kalscheuer syndrome (TOKAS). However, the mechanisms by which RNF12 E3 ubiquitin ligase activity controls specific gene expression signatures are not known. Here, we show that chromatin forms a regulatory platform for RNF12 substrate ubiquitylation and transcriptional patterning. RNF12 is recruited to specific genomic regions via a distinct consensus sequence motif, which enables targeting to key transcription factor substrate REX1. Mechanistically, RNF12 chromatin recruitment is largely REX1 independent, but is achieved via the conserved basic region (BR) adjacent to the RING domain. This region is critical for REX1 ubiquitylation on chromatin and downstream RNF12-dependent gene regulation. Furthermore, we find that RNF12 N-terminal sequences suppress chromatin recruitment and substrate ubiquitylation, uncovering a previously unappreciated autoinhibitory mechanism that governs genome targeting. Taken together, our results provide insight into mechanisms by which selective substrate targeting of an E3 ubiquitin ligase enables specific programming of gene expression.
abstract_zh:
摘要

E3泛素连接酶RNF12/RLIM控制发育基因表达，并在X连锁智力障碍疾病Tonne-Kalscheuer综合征（TOKAS）中发生突变。然而，RNF12 E3泛素连接酶活性控制特定基因表达谱的机制尚不清楚。在此，我们表明染色质为RNF12底物泛素化和转录模式形成提供了一个调控平台。RNF12通过一个独特的共有序列基序被招募到特定基因组区域，这使得其能够靶向关键转录因子底物REX1。机制上，RNF12染色质招募在很大程度上不依赖于REX1，而是通过RING结构域附近保守的基本区域（BR）实现。该区域对于染色质上REX1的泛素化以及下游RNF12依赖性基因调控至关重要。此外，我们发现RNF12 N端序列抑制染色质招募和底物泛素化，揭示了一种先前未被认识的、控制基因组靶向的自抑制机制。综合来看，我们的结果提供了对E3泛素连接酶选择性底物靶向如何实现特定基因表达编程的机制见解。
